name: mochiii-vscode
description: A local-first AI coding assistant. Your code is indexed, embedded and retrieved on your own machine.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Mochiii runs a local daemon that indexes this folder and, with your approval, edits files and runs commands in it, so it needs a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Mochiii's daemon reads the project from disk, so it cannot work on a virtual workspace.

mochiii.apiBase.markdownDescription:
Model API base URL the daemon talks to, e.g. `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`. Leave empty to use the daemon's default. Overrides `MOCHIII_API_BASE` in the environment.

This setting is **machine-scoped on purpose**: a workspace `.vscode/settings.json` must not be able to redirect your prompts to a host the repository chooses.

mochiii.model.markdownDescription:
The one model to use, named the way the server at `mochiii.apiBase` names it -- for a local server such as Ollama or LM Studio, e.g. `qwen2.5-coder:7b`. It replaces every model in `models.json`. Leave empty to use `models.json`. Sets `MOCHIII_MODEL` for the daemon.

**Machine-scoped** for the same reason as `mochiii.apiBase`: a repository must not choose which model your prompts go to.

mochiii.configPath.markdownDescription:
Absolute path to a `models.json` the daemon should load instead of the one bundled with the extension. Leave empty to use the bundled config.

The bundled config already enables the **read-only** tools (`read_file`, `list_directory`, `search_code`, `repo_map`, `grep`), confined to your workspace, with web access denied. Point this at a config of your own to add **third-party MCP servers** under `mcp.servers` (each needs `acknowledged_unconfined: true`) -- those are unconfined subprocesses, so read `docs/MCP_LANE_B_THREAT_MODEL.md` first. Editing the bundled file in place is undone by the next update; a file of your own here is not.

**Machine-scoped on purpose**, for the same reason as `mochiii.apiBase` but more so: this names programs the daemon will run in agent mode, and a workspace `.vscode/settings.json` must never be able to choose them. A relative path is refused -- it must be absolute.

mochiii.sendEditorContext.markdownDescription:
Send the file you have open with each question: its path, your cursor line, your selection, the names of your other open tabs, and the start of the file (up to 24 KB). This is what lets "what does this function do?" mean the function you are looking at.

Only files **inside the workspace** are ever sent, and only the focused editor's contents -- the other tabs contribute their names alone. Turn this off to send nothing but what you type; the model can still read workspace files with its `read_file` tool when it asks.

mochiii.history.autoSave.markdownDescription: Keep every chat in **History** (the clock button), the way Claude Code does: a chat is saved when you start a new one, open another from History, or compact it. Saved chats stay on this machine, outside the project, bounded to 50 chats and 20 MB per workspace (bookmarked chats are never removed). Turn this off to keep only the chats you bookmark.

scripts.build:runtime: npm run build:daemon && npm run build:helper && node scripts/stage-runtime.js
scripts.compile: npm run build:daemon && tsc -p ./ && npm run check:extractors && npm run build:extractors
scripts.pretest: tsc -p ./ && npm run check:extractors && npm run build:extractors && npm run check:webview && npm run check:theme && npm run check:installpath
scripts.build:package: tsc -p ./ && npm run check:extractors && npm run build:extractors && npm run bundle
